params.name: fromTokenAddress
params.description: Contract address of the token to sell (native sentinel for ETH/BNB/MATIC).

params.name: fromTokenDecimals
params.description: Decimals of the token to sell.

params.name: toTokenAddress
params.description: Contract address of the token to buy (native sentinel for ETH/BNB/MATIC).

params.name: toTokenDecimals
params.description: Decimals of the token to buy.

params.name: fromAmount
params.description: Amount of the token to sell, expressed with decimals (e.g. 1 ETH = 10**18).

params.name: userAddr
params.description: User wallet address that will execute the swap.

params.name: chainId
params.description: Chain id: 1 Ethereum, 56 BSC, 66 OEC, 128 HECO, 137 Polygon, 42161 Arbitrum One, 1285 MoonRiver, 1313161554 Aurora, 288 Boba, 43114 Avalanche.

params.name: rpc
params.description: Your own RPC node URL used for on-chain reads.

params.name: deadLine
params.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the trade deadline block.

params.name: source
params.description: Restrict liquidity sources. If blank, all sources are quoted; set to "dodo" to quote DODO v1 and DODO v2 only.

items.docs: Returns a real-time price quote and executable ABI calldata for swapping `fromAmount` of `fromTokenAddress` into `toTokenAddress` on the given chain, routed across DODO's aggregated liquidity sources. Use the native token sentinel address 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE for ETH/BNB/MATIC.
